You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module augments the hour clock specification from HourClock with a liveness requirement. It defines a specification LSpec that conjoins the inherited clock specification HC with a weak fairness condition WF_hr(HCnxt), ensuring the clock step HCnxt continues to occur fairly on the variable hr. The module also defines temporal properties stating that ticking happens infinitely often, every hour value from 1 through 12 recurs infinitely often, and the initial-state typing condition remains always true; it includes a theorem asserting these properties from LSpec and a postcondition describing a concrete counterexample structure for a settling property.
